statusbar.createaddition.wire.requires_h: This connection requires a high current wire
createaddition.ponder.electric_motor.hea: Generating Rotational Force using Electric Motors
createaddition.ponder.electric_motor.tex: Electric Motors are a compact and configurable source of Rotational Force
Scrolling on the back panel changes the RPM of the motor's rotational output
The Electric Motor requires a source of energy
The motor's energy consumption is determined by the set RPM
createaddition.ponder.alternator.header: Generating Electric energy using an Alternator
createaddition.ponder.alternator.text_1: The Alternator requires at least 32 RPM to operate
createaddition.ponder.alternator.text_2: It generates electric energy from rotational force
createaddition.ponder.alternator.text_3: Its energy production is determined by the input RPM
createaddition.ponder.rolling_mill.heade: Rolling metals into Rods and Wires
createaddition.ponder.rolling_mill.text_: The Rolling Mill uses rotational force to roll metals into Rods and Wires
To manually input items, drop Ingots or Plates on the top of the Mill
Right-click the Mill to manually retrieve the output items
createaddition.ponder.automated_rolling_: The Rolling Mill can be automated using a Belt and two Funnels
Using ComputerCraft to control an Electric Motor
The Electric Motor can be controlled using ComputerCraft
Get to the API documentation by issuing the command '/cca_api' in the chat
createaddition.ponder.tesla_coil.header: Using a Tesla Coil to charge Items
createaddition.ponder.tesla_coil.text_1: The Tesla Coil will charge Items below it
createaddition.ponder.tesla_coil.text_2: It will charge any Forge Energy Items and more!
createaddition.ponder.tesla_coil_hurt.te: The Tesla Coil is also able to inflict damage on nearby Players and Mobs
This can be activated with a Redstone signal
createaddition.ponder.liquid_blaze_burne: Giving the Blaze Burner a Straw
will allow it to accept liquid fuels by Buckets
createaddition.ponder.modular_accumulato: The Accumulator is a multi-block structure
It can store large amounts of electric energy
To improve mod compatibility, the Accumulator will actively push energy to blocks placed on the top and bottom faces.
createaddition.ponder.pei_transfer.text_: Accumulators on moving contraptions cannot connect to stationary connectors.
This component can interact with Accumulators without the need to stop the contraption.
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL Accumulators on the contraption
Energy can now be exchanged according to the Push/Pull configuration of the connector...
After no energy have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way.
createaddition.ponder.pei_redstone.text_: Redstone power will prevent the stationary interface from engaging.
createaddition.ponder.electric_pump_flow: Electric Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
The network behind is now pulling fluids...
...while the network in front is transferring it outward
A Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_1: The Alternator is a producer of energy...
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_2: ...while the Electric Motor is a consumer of energy
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_3: Producers need a connector in Pull mode, which pulls energy out of the block it is attached to
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_4: Consumers need a connector in Push mode, which pushes energy into the block it is attached to
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_5: Use a Wrench on a connector to cycle its mode
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_6: Connectors in None mode do not interact with the block they are attached to...
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_7: ...they only relay energy through their wires, so they can be placed on any block
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_8: Connect two connectors with a wire by right-clicking both using a Copper Spool
createaddition.ponder.connector.text_9: Energy now flows from the Alternator to the Electric Motor
createaddition.ponder.connector_remove.h: Removing Wires using an Empty Spool
createaddition.ponder.connector_remove.t: Right-click both ends of a wire with an Empty Spool to remove it
The wire is returned as a filled Spool
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.header: Rotating Blocks to precise Angles using the Servo Motor
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_1: The Servo Motor uses redstone to rotate attached blocks to a precise angle
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_2: It requires a source of energy (fe) to operate
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_3: Redstone power on this side turns the Servo towards its Max Angle...
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_4: ...while power on the opposite side turns it towards its Min Angle
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_5: The signals from both sides are summed, with the Min side counting as negative, so equal signals cancel each other out
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_6: How far the Servo turns depends on the strength of the summed signal
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_7: Scroll on the sides of the Servo to adjust its Max and Min Angles between 0° and 180°
createaddition.ponder.servo_motor.text_8: With the Max Angle raised to 180°, the same signal now turns it twice as far
